 Doctor X: Mafia in White: Netflix Reveals All 12 Episode Dates
 Doctor X: Mafia in White has 12 episodes, with new Netflix releases every Friday and Saturday through November 14.
 By Adriana Domingos • @sitepapodedorama @sitepapodedorama • Published on 07.11.2026 at 08:26

 Below, we have gathered the complete Doctor X: Mafia in White episode schedule on Netflix , from the premiere through the finale.

 Complete Doctor X: Mafia in White episode schedule on Netflix

 ✅ = episode already available on Netflix. Episodes marked as “Confirmed” already have a release date displayed in the catalog. As they become available, their status can be updated to “Available ✅”.
 Release dates may vary slightly by country or region, so this page follows the schedule currently displayed by Netflix and will be updated if availability changes.
 Kim Ji-won leads the cast of Doctor X: Mafia in White . (Illustrative image) When do new Doctor X: Mafia in White episodes come out?
 New episodes of Doctor X: Mafia in White are scheduled to arrive on Netflix on Fridays and Saturdays .
 After the October 9 premiere, episode 2 is scheduled for October 10. The following week, episodes 3 and 4 arrive on October 16 and 17 .
 The same pattern continues with episodes 5 and 6 on October 23 and 24 , episodes 7 and 8 on October 30 and 31 , episodes 9 and 10 on November 6 and 7 , and the final two episodes on November 13 and 14 .
 How many episodes does Doctor X: Mafia in White have?
 Doctor X: Mafia in White will have 12 episodes in total. Kim Ji-won leads the story as Gye Su-jeong, a brilliant surgeon who arrives at Guseo University Hospital and begins challenging a system shaped by hierarchy, personal interests and corruption.
 Around her are characters who occupy very different positions within that system. To understand who is who, our Doctor X: Mafia in White cast and character guide covers Kim Ji-won, Lee Jung-eun, Son Hyun-joo, Kim Woo-seok and the drama’s other key characters.
 When does Doctor X: Mafia in White end on Netflix?
 Doctor X: Mafia in White is scheduled to end on Netflix on November 14, 2026. 
 Episode 11 is scheduled for November 13, while episode 12 is set to arrive on November 14 and conclude the season, according to the schedule currently displayed by Netflix.
 That gives the drama a release period of a little over a month, with new episodes scheduled twice a week from October through mid-November.
 Kim Ji-won plays surgeon Gye Su-jeong in Doctor X: Mafia in White . What is Doctor X: Mafia in White about?
 The story follows Gye Su-jeong, played by Kim Ji-won, a brilliant surgeon who enters a hospital where power, reputation and private interests influence the decisions being made around patients.
 Her arrival begins to disrupt that structure. Confident in her own abilities and unwilling to blindly follow hierarchy, Su-jeong takes on difficult cases while clashing with powerful figures inside the hospital.
 Her greatest challenge is not limited to the operating room. Guseo University Hospital is shaped by competing ambitions, internal politics and an influential medical elite, forcing Su-jeong to confront both complicated surgeries and the system surrounding them.
 Where to watch Doctor X: Mafia in White
 Doctor X: Mafia in White is available on Netflix in supported territories. The 12-episode medical K-drama stars Kim Ji-won, Lee Jung-eun, Son Hyun-joo and Kim Woo-seok.
 Save this page to keep track of the releases: the current schedule runs from October 9 through November 14, with new episodes on Fridays and Saturdays .
